name: Biodiversity Fund

funder.name: Community Foundation Ireland (with the National Parks and Wildlife Service)

summary: Annual Irish grants for local community groups to work with an ecologist: one strand pays to develop a community biodiversity action plan, the other to carry out an existing plan's habitat and species actions.

amount.note: Plan development strand €6,000 to €10,000; implementation strand up to €12,000

geography.quote: Through the Biodiversity Fund, communities across Ireland are demonstrating how local action can deliver meaningful benefits for habitats, wildlife and biodiversity.
